gbm_population_flag.reason: Solid-tumour basket with a primary CNS tumour cohort; glioblastoma is named only in keywords and an exclusion criterion, not in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels (C7/D27B), so coded not_glioblastoma; adjudicator may consider basket_gbm_eligible.

candidate_evidence.quote: A Phase I, First-In-Human, Multicenter, Open-Label Dose Escalation and Dose Expansion Study of ABM-1310, as a Monotherapy and a Combination Therapy

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: metastatic solid tumor malignancy that has either (a) progressed on at least one line of prior standard systemic therapy, (b) for which no standard therapy exists

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Maximum plasma concentration (Cmax): Pharmacokinetic (PK) profile of ABM-1310 as a single agent and in combination therapy

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive twice daily oral doses of ABM-1310 continuously until disease progression
as monotherapy in patients with documented BRAF V600 mutation, or in combination with cobimetinib (Cotellic®)
At each dose level, ABM-1310 will be administered in combination with cobimetinib (Cotellic ®) once daily (qd) for the first 21 days of each 28-day treatment cycle.

source_quote.quote: Part A: Patients with advanced or metastatic solid tumors with documentation of positive BRAF V600E mutation, or any other BRAF V600 mutation is required for enrollment

coder_notes: ABM-1310 is the only investigational agent in the monotherapy arms (experimental_monotherapy) and is combined with cobimetinib in the combination arms (there both are effectively experimental_combination). Regimen coded combination because combination arms exist; monotherapy arms also exist. BRAF mutation (V600 for Parts A/C-1/C-2, any BRAF for Part B/C-3/C-4) is an entry requirement in every part; match relies on ABM-1310 being a BRAF inhibitor (drug knowledge, not stated in record) and cobimetinib being a MEK inhibitor. PK is plasma only. Glioblastoma screening decision is the main doubt (see flag).
